card.name: Help line after Poison in overdose text
card.fires_on: The word Help (or Information) that follows Poison or a similar service name, just before the phone number of a hotline. It appears mostly in overdosage sections.

modes.label: Poison Help line
modes.description: The word Help after Poison in the overdosage advice to call a poison control line.

card.writes: It pushes the word hot, which fits the idea of a hotline or help line.
card.plain: It marks the word naming a phone help line, such as Poison Help line, right before the number.
